textwithimage.text:
Based on the TQMa93xxLA as a platform with TSN Gigabit Ethernet, ML-Accelerator and Graphics support.

The Embedded Starterkit STKa93xxLA is a comprehensive evaluation kit built around the TQMa93xxLA mini-module, which is powered by the i.MX 93 processor, an Arm® Dual Cortex®-A55 solution from NXP. This kit is tailored to meet the needs of FPGA engineers and developers seeking advanced computing capabilities, graphics support, and machine learning acceleration.

At its core, the STKa93xxLA features the Arm® Cortex® A55 processor, known for its efficiency and processing power. The kit is equipped with a Machine Learning Accelerator boasting 0.5 TOPS (Tera Operations Per Second), making it well-suited for AI and machine learning applications.

Connectivity is a key focus of this kit, with a robust set of interfaces, including 2x Gbit Ethernet ports (1x TSN), 2x USB 2.0 interfaces, and onboard WiFi and mobile network support. This ensures high-speed communication and flexibility for various networking needs.

Graphics are also at the forefront, with an integrated graphics controller and hardware acceleration for video encoding and decoding. This feature is particularly beneficial for applications that demand graphics-intensive operations.

Furthermore, the kit includes essential interfaces such as CAN FD, digital input/output, analog input, and more, making it versatile for a wide range of applications. It also incorporates integrated security functions for enhanced system protection.

In summary, the Embedded Starterkit STKa93xxLA is an all-inclusive evaluation kit that provides FPGA engineers with the tools they need to explore the capabilities of the i.MX 93 processor, including machine learning acceleration, graphics support, and robust connectivity options, enabling them to develop and test a wide range of applications effectively.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm® Cortex® A55 Processor: Powered by the i.MX 93 processor, offering efficient and capable processing for FPGA engineers.
  • Machine Learning Accelerator: Provides 0.5 TOPS for AI and machine learning applications.
  • Versatile Connectivity: Includes 2x Gbit Ethernet ports (1x TSN), 2x USB 2.0 interfaces, and onboard WiFi and mobile network support.
  • Graphics Support: Equipped with an integrated graphics controller and hardware acceleration for graphics-intensive tasks.
  • Comprehensive Interface Options: Offers CAN FD, digital input/output, analog input, and other essential interfaces for versatile application development
